Earth Punishment and Prayer of Amplification are your damage buffs (Prayer is self-only; tested level-25 damage order: Prayer > Earth Punishment > Light > Noble Aura). Benevolence is your group heal-over-time and cleanse. Salvation is your personal invulnerability; some dungeons (Deus, Noiran) need it.

builds.why: What top Global Clerics run (per player, top 20 per boss: Earth Punishment 100%, Prayer 94%, Noble Aura 85%, Light of Protection 43%) and what Korea's top 20 run. The Global sheet's own priority is different: 1. Light of Protection, 2. Earth Punishment, 3. Absolution, 4. Summon Resurrection, swapping Light of Protection for Prayer of Amplification or Resurrection with a Chanter. Light of Protection takes slot 4 only when no Chanter runs Undefeated Mantra.
